scripts.test:gates: node --test scripts/quality-self-test.cjs scripts/spa-routing.test.cjs scripts/publish-chatgpt-tasks.test.cjs scripts/cv-private-policy.test.cjs scripts/avatar-cache-policy.test.cjs scripts/check-project-docs.test.cjs scripts/dependency-license-inventory.test.cjs scripts/check-dependency-licenses.test.cjs
scripts.typecheck: npm --prefix authorizer run typecheck && .venv-quality/bin/mypy --check-untyped-defs --ignore-missing-imports rotation-function/rotate.py scripts/package-python.py scripts/check-python-licenses.py
scripts.format:check: terraform fmt -check -recursive && biome format . && .venv-quality/bin/ruff format --check rotation-function scripts
scripts.build: npm --prefix authorizer run build && PATH="$PWD/.venv-quality/bin:$PATH" bash rotation-function/build.sh && npm run build:placeholder
scripts.test: npm --prefix authorizer test && .venv-quality/bin/python3 -m unittest discover -s rotation-function/tests -v
